description: This file defines the ClusterSingletonSupervisorActor class, an Akka actor responsible for supervising singleton cluster actors with custom supervision strategies, including error handling and actor system termination.

classes.name: ClusterSingletonSupervisorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that supervises singleton cluster actors with a configurable supervision strategy, handling various exceptions and system termination.

methods.name: buildDefaultSupervisorStrategy
methods.description: Constructs the default supervision strategy with specific error handling rules.

methods.name: restartChild
methods.description: Logs restart action and returns a directive to restart the child actor.

methods.name: terminateActorSystem
methods.description: Logs and terminates the actor system.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory methods to create Props configurations for this actor with specified child Props and supervision strategy.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns the supervision strategy used by this actor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling to forward all messages to the child actor.
